title: Break It Down Again
original_lyrics:
[bridge]
So those are my dreams
And these are my eyes
Stand tall like man
Head strong like horse
Amj7
When it's all mixed up

[chorus]
It's in the way you're always hiding from the light
See for yourself you have been sitting on time bomb
No revolution maybe someone somewhere else

[chorus]
And all the love and all the love in the world
Won't stop the rain from fallling, waste seeping underground
I want to break it down (break it down again)

[bridge]
So those are my schemes
And these are my plans
Hot tips for the boys
Fresh news from the force
When it's all mixed up

[chorus]
No sleep for dreaming say the architects of life

[bridge]
They make no mention for the beauty of decay

[bridge]
And all the love and all the love in the world
Won't stop the rain from falling
Waste seeping underground
I want to break it down (break it down again)

[chorus]
Horsing around
Pray to the power
Play to the crowd with your big hit sound
And they won't simmer won't simmer won't simmer down
Play to the crowd
Play to the crowd
Play

[chorus]
It's in the way you always hiding from the light
Fast off from heaven just like Moses on motorbike
No revolution maybe someone somewhere else

[chorus]
I want to break it down (break it down again)
Ending:
(No chord)

[bridge]
No more sleepy dreaming
No more building up
It is time to dissolve

[bridge]
No more sleepy dreaming
